brief: A jug with a lid to mix my baby's formula milk in and keep it in the fridge.

requirements.evidence: No jug built. Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed plastic with fit-only checking; the system cannot verify food safety, waterproofing, or dishwasher/fridge safety, so an infant food-contact vessel cannot be made safe here.
requirements.requirement: Jug vessel to mix baby formula milk in

requirements.evidence: No lid built for the same reason; a printed cover cannot be verified as food-safe or leak-proof.
Mixing and storing infant formula requires a food-safe, waterproof, easily sterilised container; printed layer lines can harbour bacteria and leak, which the configurator does not check.
requirements.requirement: Safe for mixing and fridge-storing baby's formula milk

finish.summary: Declined: a jug for baby formula is a food-contact infant-feeding vessel. Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed plastic and the configurator checks fit only — it knows nothing about food safety, waterproofing, or sterilisation — so I cannot make this safe to use. Use a commercial food-grade formula mixing jug/pitcher instead. I could build a fridge-door caddy or shelf organizer to hold that commercial jug, if you want.

events.text: Building a lidded mixing jug — I'll see what food-safe shapes the system can make.
